"""
Authentication router - Handles login, logout, and token management
"""

from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Dict, Any, Tuple

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status, Request
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

import config
from schemas.auth import LoginResponse, TokenValidationResponse
from services import auth_service, audit_service
from middleware.security import get_current_user
from database.database import get_db

router = APIRouter()


def _get_client_info(request: Request) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    """Extract client IP and user agent from request"""
    client_ip = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"
    user_agent = request.headers.get("user-agent", "unknown")
    return client_ip, user_agent


@router.post("/login", response_model=LoginResponse)
async def login(
    request: Request,
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """
    Authenticate user and return access token.
    Uses OAuth2 password flow (username + password in form data).
    """
    user = auth_service.authenticate_user(db, form_data.username, form_data.password)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect username or password",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    
    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=config.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    access_token = auth_service.create_access_token(
        data={"sub": str(user["id"]), "username": user["username"]},
        expires_delta=access_token_expires,
    )
    
    # Log successful login
    client_ip, user_agent = _get_client_info(request)
    audit_service.log_login(db, user["id"], client_ip, user_agent)
    
    return LoginResponse(
        access_token=access_token,
        token_type="bearer",
        expires_in=config.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES * 60,
        user_id=user["id"],
        username=user["username"],
        name=user["name"],
    )


@router.post("/logout")
async def logout(
    request: Request,
    current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """
    Logout user and invalidate token.
    Note: With stateless JWT, we just acknowledge logout.
    For true invalidation, implement a token blacklist.
    """
    # Log logout event
    client_ip, user_agent = _get_client_info(request)
    audit_service.log_logout(db, current_user["id"], client_ip, user_agent)
    
    return {"message": "Successfully logged out", "username": current_user["username"]}


@router.post("/refresh", response_model=LoginResponse)
async def refresh_token(current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """
    Refresh access token - issues a new token for an authenticated user.
    """
    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=config.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    access_token = auth_service.create_access_token(
        data={"sub": str(current_user["id"]), "username": current_user["username"]},
        expires_delta=access_token_expires,
    )
    
    return LoginResponse(
        access_token=access_token,
        token_type="bearer",
        expires_in=config.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES * 60,
        user_id=current_user["id"],
        username=current_user["username"],
        name=current_user["name"],
    )


@router.get("/validate", response_model=TokenValidationResponse)
async def validate_token(current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """
    Validate current access token.
    Returns user info if token is valid.
    """
    return TokenValidationResponse(
        is_valid=True,
        user_id=current_user["id"],
        username=current_user["username"],
    )


@router.get("/me")
async def get_current_user_info(current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """
    Get current authenticated user information.
    """
    # Return user info without hashed_password
    return {
        "id": current_user["id"],
        "username": current_user["username"],
        "email": current_user["email"],
        "name": current_user["name"],
        "phone": current_user.get("phone"),
        "profile_picture": current_user.get("profile_picture"),
    }

"""
Authentication service - Business logic for authentication
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any

from passlib.context import CryptContext
from jose import JWTError, jwt
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

import config
from database.models import User

# Password hashing context
pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto", bcrypt__rounds=config.BCRYPT_ROUNDS)


def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    """
    Verify a plain password against a hashed password
    """
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)


def get_password_hash(password: str) -> str:
    """
    Hash a plain password
    """
    return pwd_context.hash(password)


def _user_to_dict(user: User) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Convert User model to dictionary"""
    return {
        "id": user.id,
        "username": user.username,
        "email": user.email,
        "name": user.name,
        "hashed_password": user.hashed_password,
        "phone": user.phone,
        "profile_picture": user.profile_picture,
    }


def authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Authenticate user with username and password
    Returns user dict if successful, None otherwise
    """
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == username).first()
    if not user:
        return None
    if not verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return None
    return _user_to_dict(user)


def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> str:
    """
    Create a new JWT access token
    """
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=config.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, config.SECRET_KEY, algorithm=config.ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt


def verify_token(token: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Verify and decode a JWT token
    Returns token data if valid, None otherwise
    """
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, config.SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[config.ALGORITHM])
        return payload
    except JWTError:
        return None


def get_current_user_from_token(db: Session, token: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Get the current user from a valid token
    """
    payload = verify_token(token)
    if payload is None:
        return None
    user_id = payload.get("sub")
    if user_id is None:
        return None
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == int(user_id)).first()
    return _user_to_dict(user) if user else None


def get_user_by_username(db: Session, username: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Get user by username
    """
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == username).first()
    return _user_to_dict(user) if user else None


def get_user_by_id(db: Session, user_id: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Get user by ID
    """
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    return _user_to_dict(user) if user else None


def update_user(db: Session, user_id: int, updates: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Update user fields in the database.
    Returns the updated user dict, or None if user not found.
    """
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if user is None:
        return None

    for key, value in updates.items():
        if key in ("name", "email", "phone", "profile_picture", "username"):
            setattr(user, key, value)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return _user_to_dict(user)


def update_password(db: Session, user_id: int, current_password: str, new_password: str) -> bool:
    """
    Change a user's password after verifying the current one.
    Returns True on success, False if current password doesn't match.
    """
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if user is None:
        return False
    if not verify_password(current_password, user.hashed_password):
        return False
    user.hashed_password = get_password_hash(new_password)
    db.commit()
    return True

No, hardcoding `http://127.0.0.1:8080` everywhere is **not correct practice**. If the server URL changes (e.g., production deployment), you'd have to update every single fetch call.

### Fix: Create a config file with the base URL

````javascript

const API_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api";
````

### Add it to all your HTML pages (before other scripts)

````html

<!-- ...existing code... -->
    <script src="js/config.js"></script>
    <script src="js/main.js"></script>
    <script src="js/auth.js"></script>
    <script src="js/navigation.js"></script>
    <script src="js/dashboard.js"></script>
<!-- ...existing code... -->
````

Do the same for `login.html`, `landing.html`, `settings.html`, and any other HTML files.

### Then update all your fetch calls

**dashboard.js:**
````javascript

// ...existing code...
const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/auth/validate`, {
// ...existing code...
````

---

### Summary

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| `'http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/auth/login'` | `` `${API_BASE_URL}/auth/login` `` |
| Change URL in every file | Change **one line** in `config.js` |
| Breaks on deployment | Easy to switch to production URL |

Now when you deploy, just change `config.js` to:
```javascript
const API_BASE_URL = "https://your-production-server.com/api";
```

/**

/**

async function loadIDMSData() {
    // TODO: Fetch IDMS data from API
    const authToken = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
    if (!authToken) {
        window.location.href = 'login.html';
        return;
    }

    try {
        // Fetch user data from the API
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/dashboard/idms-data`, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}`
            }
        });

    const tableData = await response.json();
    //console.log(tableData);
    renderDataTable(tableData);

    } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error fetching user data:', error);
    }
}

    // TODO: Populate data table with IDMS data

    const columnNames = Object.keys(data.data[0]);

/**
 * Dashboard JS - Dashboard page functionality
 */

/**
 * Load IDMS data for the data table
 */
async function loadIDMSData() {
    // TODO: Fetch IDMS data from API
    const authToken = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
    if (!authToken) {
        window.location.href = 'login.html';
        return;
    }

    try {
        // Fetch user data from the API
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/dashboard/idms-data`, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}`
            }
        });

    const tableData = await response.json();
    //console.log(tableData);
    renderDataTable(tableData);

    } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error fetching user data:', error);
    }
}

/**
 * Render data table with IDMS data
 * @param {Array} data - IDMS data array
 */
function renderDataTable(data) {
    // TODO: Populate data table with IDMS data
    console.log(data);
    const table_head = document.getElementById("table-head");

    table_head.innerHTML = "";

    const columnNames = Object.keys(data.data[0]);
    console.log(columnNames);

    // fill in table headers

    // fill in table body

        columnNames.forEach(col => {

        });

}

async function loadAPIUsageStats() {
    // TODO: Fetch API usage data from API
    const startDateInput = document.getElementById("start-date");
    const endDateInput = document.getElementById("end-date");

    // listen for the filter button click
    document.getElementById("filter-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {

    });
}

 * @param {Date} startDate
 * @param {Date} endDate
*/
async function renderTotalAPICalls(startDate, endDate) {
        
    const authToken = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
    if (!authToken) {
        window.location.href = 'login.html';
        return;
    }

    console.log(startDate);
    console.log(endDate);

    // call the get using the dates
    try {
        // Fetch user data from the API
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/dashboard/api-usage/total?start_date=${startDate}&end_date=${endDate}`, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}`,
            }
        });

        const api_total_calls = await response.json();
        console.log(api_total_calls.total_calls);

        // display that total number
        const total_number_holder = document.getElementById("total-api-calls");
        total_number_holder.innerHTML = api_total_calls.total_calls;

    } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error fetching user data:', error);
    }
}

/**
 * Render API usage statistics
 * @param {Date} startDate
 * @param {Date} endDate
 */
async function renderAPIBreakdown(startDate, endDate) {
    // TODO: Display API call count and breakdown

    const authToken = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
    if (!authToken) {
        window.location.href = 'login.html';
        return;
    }

     // call the get using the dates
    try {
        // Fetch user API data
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/dashboard/api-usage/breakdown?start_date=${startDate}&end_date=${endDate}`, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}`,
            }
        });

        const breakdownTableData = await response.json();
        //console.log(breakdownTableData);

        // render the table
        renderBreakdownTableData(breakdownTableData);
    
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error fetching user data:', error);
    }

}

/**
 * @param {Array} data - API breakdown array
 */
function renderBreakdownTableData(data) {
    // TODO: Populate data table with the API Breakdown by page
    const table_head = document.getElementById("breakdown-table-head");

    table_head.innerHTML = "";

    console.log(data);

    const columnNames = Object.keys(data.breakdown[0]);
    console.log(columnNames);

    // find the percentage column
    const percentCol = columnNames.find(name => name.toLowerCase().includes("percent"));

    // sort by percentage descending
    data.breakdown.sort((a, b) => {
        return (b[percentCol] || 0) - (a[percentCol] || 0);
    });

    // fill in table headers
    columnNames.forEach(name => {
        const header = document.createElement("th");
        header.innerHTML = `${name}`;
        table_head.appendChild(header);
    });
    // add visual bar header
    const barHeader = document.createElement("th");
    barHeader.innerHTML = "Graph";
    table_head.appendChild(barHeader);

    const table_body = document.getElementById("breakdown-table-body");
    table_body.innerHTML = "";

    // fill in table body
    data.breakdown.forEach(rowData => {
        const row = document.createElement("tr");
        columnNames.forEach(col => {
            const td = document.createElement("td");
            td.innerHTML = rowData[col]; // get value by key
            row.appendChild(td);
        });

        // add visual bar cell
        const barTd = document.createElement("td");
        barTd.classList.add("bar-cell");
        const barContainer = document.createElement("div");
        barContainer.classList.add("bar-container");
        const bar = document.createElement("div");
        bar.classList.add("bar-fill");
        const pct = rowData[percentCol] || 0;
        bar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
        barContainer.appendChild(bar);
        barTd.appendChild(barContainer);
        row.appendChild(barTd);

        table_body.appendChild(row);
    });

}

/**
 * Initialize date range inputs with default values
 */
function initDateRangeInputs() {
    // TODO: Set default date range (e.g., last 30 days)
    const startDateInput = document.getElementById("start-date");
    const endDateInput = document.getElementById("end-date");

    const today = new Date();
    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date();
    thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(today.getDate() - 30);

    // format end date (today)
    const endFormatted = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
    // format start date (30 days ago)
    const startFormatted = thirtyDaysAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];

    if (endDateInput) {
        endDateInput.value = endFormatted;
    }
    if (startDateInput) {
        startDateInput.value = startFormatted;
    }

    // click the button to actually filter
    const button = document.getElementById("filter-btn");
    button.click();

}

// Initialize on DOM load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    loadIDMSData();
    loadAPIUsageStats();    // attach listener first
    initDateRangeInputs();  // then set defaults & click
});
